title: Tuya Devices Configuration
description: JSON configuration for devices handled by the Tuya MQTT bridge.

items.title: Tuya Device
items.description: Configuration for one Tuya device handled by the MQTT bridge.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier used in MQTT topics and Home Assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Display name for the Tuya device in Home Assistant.

device_id.title: Tuya device ID
device_id.description: Device identifier assigned by Tuya and required by tinytuya.

local_key.title: Tuya local key
local_key.description: Local encryption key used to communicate with the Tuya device.

ip.title: IP address or hostname
ip.description: Local IP address or hostname of the Tuya device.

version.title: Tuya protocol version
version.description: Tuya local protocol version used by tinytuya. Defaults to 3.3.

device_type.title: Device profile
device_type.description: Logical device profile used to describe the Tuya device and support future device types.

datapoints.description: Mapping of logical functions to Tuya Data Point identifiers. Additional functions may be added for future profiles.

switch.title: Switch DP
switch.description: Tuya Data Point identifier controlling the device switch or valve.
